candidate_grammar.boundary: Every admitted positive finite single-central coordination entity and its complete distinct direct-incidence support, tested after seal against all twenty-three registered IUPAC and NIST definition, structure, count and limitation records.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of carrier, membership, quantity, identity, absence, observation, boundary and extension forms; decide all 256 forms solely from admitted complete coordination identity, exact finite incidence and source-boundary laws.

excluded_inputs: negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, signed or continuum proof value
imported coordination-number table, valence rule, geometry catalogue, ligand-field or bonding model
observed 3, 4 or 5 count before prediction seal
selected complex, omitted boundary or limitation row, fitted distance or target-derived correction
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census, one survivor, depth-independent direct-incidence successor, implementation-distinct count reconstruction, capability-closed twenty-three-record IUPAC/NIST vector, exact 3/4/5 post-seal comparison, complete alternate-sense, pi-exclusion, absence and disclaimer retention, omission, centre-mismatch and numerical-zero controls.
statement: For an admitted complete coordination entity, coordination number is exactly the positive cardinality of distinct direct ligand-incidence traces on the retained central occurrence. Equal ligand-group labels do not collapse occurrences; structural absence contributes no incidence; the next direct attachment preserves all prior traces and adds exactly one.
title: Exact coordination number from generated central-ligand incidence
